title: Golden workbook fails its own verifier because cached calculations are inconsistent
evidence: Submitting gt_09_golden.xlsx itself to the configured verifier returns score=0.0: 'FAILED - regression 0.9946, modification 1.0000. 34 cell error(s)'. The verifier recalculates the submission but compares it against unrecalculated golden caches. Those caches are internally inconsistent: LBO!I138 contains '=IF($F138-I135<0,0,$F138-I135)' and caches 1034.97097384539, although F138=1800 and I135=794.347085505223 imply 1005.652914494777. Recalculation also changes LBO!D213 from '6% / 1.4x' to '6% / 1.3x'. The resulting regression ratio is below the required 0.998 threshold. Because this is the sole verifier, with weight 1, even the supplied golden answer receives zero credit.
confirmation: Verified: LBO!I138 '=IF($F138-I135<0,0,$F138-I135)' caches 1034.97 vs 1005.65 implied by the cached inputs. The inconsistent golden caches make every recalculated submission, the GT included, fail regression.

title: Ground-truth workbook fails its own grader, so the problem cannot be passed
evidence: I ran score_workbooks (the verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells logic: recalculate in LibreOffice, mode=values, answer_position from spec.yaml) on three files. gt_09_golden.xlsx itself got regression 0.9946 / modification 1.0. That is below REGRESSION_PASS_RATIO=0.998, so it scores 0.0, with 34 cell errors, e.g. 'LBO!D213: answer=6% / 1.4x, output=6% / 1.3x', 'LBO!I138: answer=1034.97, output=1005.65', 'LBO!J138: answer=856.35, output=798.76', 'LBO!J124: answer=205.70, output=208.67'. The input with the correct fix (every INDEX(...,OpCase±1) changed to INDEX(...,OpCase), the only difference between input and GT) got regression 0.9571 / modification 0.9058, so it also scores 0. Likely cause: LBO has a circular revolver-interest calculation (I136 '=AVERAGE(I132,I135)*(($D136/10000)+I$127)' feeding I123/I133/I134/I135; calcPr iterate="true" iterateCount="100" iterateDelta="0.0001"). LibreOffice resolves it to different values than the Excel-cached GT, and the drift spreads across the debt schedule and returns cells. The sole verifier (weight 1) is all-or-nothing, so every agent gets 0 whether it fixes the file or not.
confirmation: The GT's cached LBO!I138 = 1034.97, but its formula with F138 = 1800 and I135 = 794.35 gives 1005.65. All 3 trials fail only on regression (0.9944 < 0.998) with modification 1.0, so the problem cannot be passed.
fix: files/gt/gt_09_golden.xlsx: rewrote only the cached values of 257 formula cells (circular revolver/interest loop in LBO and its dependents, e.g. LBO!I138 1034.97 -> 1004.46, J124 205.70 -> 208.86, D213 '6% / 1.4x' -> '6% / 1.3x') to the converged fixed point of the GT's own formulas, taken from repeated LibreOffice recalculation (the verifier's own recalc routine). Formulas, styles and LBO!D8 (=TODAY()) unchanged. Local check: patched GT PASSes against itself; the original Excel-cached GT also PASSes against it; an input with the 30 INDEX(...,OpCase) fixes PASSes once its circular loop is recalculated to convergence (repeated recalcs converge to the same values as the GT) Cleanup: answer_position 'LBO'!A2:X218 split into the same 79 sub-ranges as Debugging 09_06 (identical golden), leaving out the 294 loop cells (LBO G67:N205 loop cells, D213, L213) that do not settle under one LibreOffice recalc; guidance range text updated. Real scorer: golden 1.0, original Excel-cached golden 1.0, input with the 30 INDEX fixes saved by openpyxl 1.0 (FAIL under the old range) and after 1 or 2 prior recalcs 1.0, untouched input FAIL (mod).

title: Golden workbook cached values are unconverged on circular references, causing the cell-value verifier to fail even on the golden workbook itself
evidence: In problem.py, the agent is instructed: 'Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies...' In spec.yaml, the sole verifier 'SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check' (verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells, weight: 1) grades /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx against gt_path='gt_09_golden.xlsx' and reference_path='untouched_input_Incorrect Index Match_input.xlsx' over answer_position="'LBO'!A2:X218,'Financials'!A2:Q29,'Operating Cases'!A2:Q47" in mode='values'. Across the entire workbook, there are exactly 30 formula differences between the input file and gt_09_golden.xlsx: off-by-one INDEX(..., OpCase+1) and INDEX(..., OpCase-1) formulas in LBO!I6, Operating Cases!F9:N9, Operating Cases!F25:N25, Operating Cases!Q25, and Operating Cases!E33:N33, all corrected to INDEX(..., OpCase) in gt_09_golden.xlsx. However, the LBO sheet contains an active iterative circular reference loop (circ at LBO!H8 = 1; Revolver Draw G133:N133 -> Ending Balance G135:N135 -> Interest G136:N136 & Unused Fee G137:N137 -> Interest Expense G67:N67 -> Net Income G69:N69 -> FCF G99:N99 -> Cash Flow before Revolver G123:N123 -> Revolver Draw G133:N133), and gt_09_golden.xlsx was saved before its iterative calculation converged. Consequently, gt_09_golden.xlsx's cached values violate its own formulas: for example, LBO!G124 has formula '=+G133' with cached value 302.331140639508 while LBO!G133 in the same file has cached value 302.546887790176; LBO!H124 ('=+H133') has cached value 272.496372058257 while LBO!H133 is 273.348432267803; LBO!J124 ('=+J133') has cached value 205.703600930112 while LBO!J133 is 208.670134280738. Furthermore, 35 downstream cells in LBO (including D213, H204, I138, J124, J138, J199, K124, K137, K138, K199, L103, L124, L136:L138, L199:L201, L204, L213, M124, M137, M138, M199:M201, N82, N83, N124, N137, N138, N199:N201) had cached '#VALUE!' errors in the input workbook (propagating from Operating Cases!F33:N33) but unchanged formulas, so score_workbooks classifies them via the _has_excel_error formula-fallback rule as regression cells (requiring a 0.998 pass ratio across 6,349 regression cells, i.e., at most 12 mismatches). Because verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells forces a LibreOffice recalculation on output_path while comparing against the un-recalculated cached values in gt_09_golden.xlsx, grading gt_09_golden.xlsx against itself fails with score=0.0 ('FAILED - regression 0.9946, modification 1.0000. 34 cell error(s)'), and any properly converged solution with the exact golden formulas fails with score=0.0 ('regression 0.9944, modification 1.0000. 35 cell error(s)').
confirmation: Confirmed: in gt_09_golden.xlsx, LBO!G124 (=+G133) caches 302.3311 while G133 caches 302.5469, and J124/J133 are 205.70/208.67. The cached values violate their own direct-reference formulas, so the values verifier fails even the GT.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check falsely fails all 3 units (and fails the golden workbook itself) due to unconverged circular-reference cached values in gt_09_golden.xlsx
evidence: Across all 3 units (weight: 1, 100% of total score), the verifier returns the exact same failure: 'score=0 - FAILED - regression 0.9944, modification 1.0000. 35 cell error(s): Regression error at LBO!D213: answer=6% / 1.4x, output=6% / 1.3x; Regression error at LBO!H204: answer=0.00413401166586813, output=0.00405897791165111; Regression error at LBO!I138: answer=1034.97097384539, output=1004.45756004728; Regression error at LBO!J124: answer=205.703600930112, output=208.861535768425; Regression error at LBO!J138: answer=856.353312977964, output=795.59602427886'. Reconstructing each attempt's work from its trajectory shows that all 3 units solved the task completely and identically to the golden formulas: in unit 1 (steps [17]-[49]), unit 2 (steps [15]-[57]), and unit 3 (steps [16]-[72]), the agent located all 30 buggy INDEX(..., OpCase+1) and INDEX(..., OpCase-1) formulas in LBO!I6 and Operating Cases rows 9, 25, and 33, replaced them with INDEX(..., OpCase) (matching 100% of the formula changes in gt_09_golden.xlsx and achieving modification=1.0000), and recalculated the workbook in LibreOffice until the iterative circular reference loop (Revolver Draw <-> Interest Expense) converged. Because verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells recalculates output_path in LibreOffice (force_recalculation=True) but compares against the un-recalculated cached values in gt_09_golden.xlsx, even passing gt_09_golden.xlsx itself as output_path scores 0.0 (regression 0.9946 < 0.998, 34 cell errors).
